name: edmonds-lyra-graeca
title: J. M. Edmonds, Lyra Graeca (Loeb Classical Library), vols I-III: per-fragment OCR segmentation
pd_basis: published 1922/1924/1927 - US public domain (pre-1931 publication); revised vol. I published 1928 - likewise pre-1931

volumes.edition: Lyra Graeca vol. I, first edition (London: Heinemann; New York: Putnam)
Lyra Graeca vol. I, revised and augmented edition (London: Heinemann; New York: Putnam)
Lyra Graeca vol. II (London: Heinemann; New York: Putnam)
Lyra Graeca vol. III (London: Heinemann; New York: Putnam)

method: IA djvu.xml (Tesseract) lines with coordinates; accent-row/speck lines dropped
running head = first line in top 12% of page; printed page number from bottom-line OCR, propagated by local majority offset

footnote block = highest large vertical gap in the lower page followed by a left-aligned numbered note line, set in small type, with no centred fragment number below it; footnotes are kept per page, not cut per fragment
page role: Greek (Greek-letter ratio > 0.3, or < 15% English function words) vs English; facing spread = Greek page followed by English page
fragment marker = short centred line reading as a number (+ optional a-d suffix, ', N' pair, footnote digit, or capitals title), or an unreadable tiny centred line of number height
markers of the two facing pages aligned (Needleman-Wunsch) with a hard vertical-position constraint (Edmonds prints corresponding numbers at the same height)

numbers chosen per poet by a longest ascending chain (dynamic programming over all OCR readings, incl. dropping a trailing superscript footnote digit); unplaced markers between numbers a and a+k+1 receive a+1..a+k (flagged inferred); unplaced two-page markers kept as boundaries (flagged out_of_sequence); unplaced one-page markers dropped

fragment text = body lines from its marker to the next marker on the same page side; when the number was not found on one page, that page's boundary is placed at the facing number's height (flagged); cut at a centred all-caps heading or a running-head change
english_source_line = English segment up to its first colon within 250 characters (Edmonds' italic source note ends with a colon); greek_source_ref = Latin-letter text before the first Greek letter
Greek is uncorrected OCR (never corrected by hand); vol. III Greek is unusable (Latin-only OCR)

spot_check.auditor: independent subagent, visual comparison with IA page images (round 2, final build)

spot_check_round1_prefix.auditor: independent subagent, visual comparison with IA page images
spot_check_round1_prefix.note: first audit, run on an earlier build; its failures (footnotes leaking into fragment ends, number/title lines kept as text, missed page-signature lines) led to the footnote and boundary fixes in this script. Error rates of the final build are in spot_check.

campbell_glp_mapping.method: exact Greek incipit match (first 20 normalised Greek letters of the Campbell text found in the same poet's Edmonds Greek OCR segment); Edmonds prints no Campbell cross-references (Campbell 1967 postdates him)

source_search.conclusion: No clean transcription (TEI, Wikisource, Gutenberg) of Edmonds' Lyra Graeca exists on an open host; the best open digital form is Internet Archive page OCR. Among the IA scans, the Princeton-contributed 2022 Tesseract derivations (lyragraecabeingr01unse, lyragraecabeingr02unse) and the 1928 revised vol. I (lyragraeca0001jmed_c0b1) were OCR'd with Greek models and give real Greek text; the Toronto scans already in data/raw/lyra (lyragraecabeingr01edmouoft, lyragraecavol20002jmed, lyragraecabeingr03edmouoft) have Latin-only OCR (no Greek characters at all). No open vol. III scan with Greek OCR was found.

candidates.result: Greek-capable OCR: lyragraecabeingr01unse (vol. I, title page 'MCMXXII', Tesseract 5 '-l grc+eng'); lyragraecabeingr02unse (vol. II, 'MCMXXIV', Tesseract 5 '-l eng+grc'); lyragraeca0002unse (vol. II, Tesseract 4.1.1, Greek present; not used, r02unse preferred); lyragraeca0001jmed_c0b1 (vol. I 'REVISED AND AUGMENTED EDITION', 'MCMXXVIII', 'Second and enlarged edition'; Greek present). Latin-only OCR: lyragraecabeingr03unse (vol. III, 'MCMXXVII', Tesseract '-l eng'), lyragraeca0003jmed (vol. III), lyragraeca0001jmed (vol. I 1922), lyragraecabeing00edmogoog, and the three Toronto items already in data/raw/lyra. Lending-restricted (not used): lyragraecavol10000jmed (1952), bwb_W9-DEI-866 (1959), bwb_KU-141-865_3 (1967). User uploads of Loeb PDFs ('loeb.-144...', 'L144LyraGraecaIII...') were not used.
